question: Is the original frozen Stage1 A_0 SOXL-relative selection loss, especially 2026Q3, concentrated in a few anomalous price days or distributed across many normal open-to-open intervals? A concentration result only directs a separate source-quality audit; it is not a tradable rule.

fixed_statistics.full_calendar: All 944 same-order signal/trade/exit dates and full 16 quarters
fixed_statistics.concentration_fraction: sum absolute 10 most negative daily SOXL_selection_log / sum absolute all negative daily SOXL_selection_log, separately full path and 2026Q3; also save all quarter counts/sums
fixed_statistics.data_quality_triage: If 2026Q3 top10 fraction >=0.70, only then suggest a separately frozen independent-price/corporate-action outlier audit; otherwise treat loss as distributed before selecting next source mechanism. This is not a factor gate or economic optimization.
fixed_statistics.source_return_check: Report frame.soxl_return minus frame.soxx_return on the listed days as saved Qlib price-plane context; never treat this price-plane difference as exact physical fee-net account contribution.

stop: Any source hash, date order, 944 calendar, SOXL component closure to already saved summary, Qlib DatasetH or NAS restore failure stops. No source price overrides, trades, fit or account replay.
